name: orbit
description: A desktop pet that shows what your Claude Code sessions are doing

scripts.icons: node scripts/gen-icons.mjs && iconutil -c icns src-tauri/icons/orbit.iconset -o src-tauri/icons/icon.icns && rm -rf src-tauri/icons/orbit.iconset
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
